answer: Latency fingerprint dedup: a new identity answers timed pings from three probe nodes, and identities with round-trip profiles within 2 ms merge into one voting weight. Wallets on one copper rack share one profile. Separate weight needs separate hosts at 5 USD a month: 1 fake identity costs 5, 10 fake identities cost 50, 100 cost 500 per month, while an honest user pays once. Auditors replay 10 percent of pings and publish an ivory ledger of merged groups; a forged profile loses a 50 POA bond. Limitation: each signal is noisy, so false merges occur.
